lines.zh: 深海的重量把我压成一块软糖。
lines.en: The deep sea's weight presses me into soft candy.

lines.zh: 我划水像一团缓慢的果冻。
lines.en: I paddle along like a slow lump of jelly.
Only under deep pressure am I truly myself.

lines.zh: 我的鳍太小，只好让水推我。
lines.en: My fins are tiny, so the water pushes me.

lines.zh: 往上浮一点，我就开始发软。
lines.en: Rise a little and I start going soft.
I creep along, hugging the seafloor.

lines.zh: 冷水流过我半透明的身体。
lines.en: Cold current slides through my see-through body.

lines.zh: 我从不在阳光照到的地方游。
lines.en: I never swim where sunlight reaches.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴拖着一团黏液。
lines.en: My tail drags a trail of slime.
Every flick of me comes half a beat late.
Grit rolls beneath my belly as I go.

lines.zh: 我朝更黑更冷的地方去。
lines.en: I head for somewhere darker and colder.

lines.zh: 深处的水把我托得很稳。
lines.en: The deep water holds me steady.
I drift past the shadow of a sunken ship.

lines.zh: 我慢慢的，把泥一口口推过去。
lines.en: Slowly, I push the mud aside mouthful by mouthful.

lines.zh: 暗流拐了个弯，我也跟着拐。
lines.en: The dark current turns, and I turn with it.
Bloop bloop bloop
Slow swim
Surface glide
I drift along looking for food, slowly.

lines.zh: 下雨了，我这团软肉浮起来。
lines.en: Rain comes, and this soft lump floats up.
Swallow droplets
Float on surface
Touch explodes
Bloop bloop swim
Rain swims

lines.zh: 咕嘟，身子一抽一抽往前。
lines.en: Glub, my body jerks forward bit by bit.
In the rain I slowly float up.
I slide on the surface without sinking.
One tail flick moves me a little.
Soft and spread out, I inch forward.
I walk on the water like solid ground.

lines.zh: 我就这样浮着，像一块旧抹布。
lines.en: I just float here like an old rag.

lines.zh: 我的脸天生就一副委屈样。
lines.en: My face looks heartbroken by design.
One drop in pressure and I panic.

lines.zh: 我听见鲸歌从很远传来。
lines.en: I hear whale song from very far away.

lines.zh: 这团凝胶里没有多少骨头。
lines.en: There is hardly any bone in this gel.
I blink, very slowly.
The seabed mud is softer than I am.
I am waiting for a shrimp to pass by.

lines.zh: 我的鼻子垂下来，挡视线。
lines.en: My nose droops down and blocks my view.
So quiet, only the water speaks.
I stay still and save my strength.
Something is crawling across my back.
I let out one very small bubble.
I feel like something someone forgot here.
Lazily lounging
Sink into water
Once the pressure leaves, I sag.
The pressure leaves me all slack.

lines.zh: 我贴着海底，像一团果冻。
lines.en: I hug the seabed like a lump of jelly.
Roll lazily
Surface briefly
Bloop bloop vocal
Quietly watch
Bloop bloop bubble
I lie spread on the water, still.
Rain taps my back and I sway.
Gills opening and closing, I breathe slow.
A soft lump, too lazy to move.
You carry the dry smell of land.

lines.zh: 你的灯照得我皮肤发亮。
lines.en: Your lamp makes my skin glow.

lines.zh: 你潜得这么深，不怕压吗。
lines.en: You dive this deep and do not fear the pressure?

lines.zh: 你的靴子踩起了海底的泥。
lines.en: Your boots stir up the seabed mud.

lines.zh: 我从没见过这么硬的东西。
lines.en: I have never seen anything so firm.
The bucket in your hand makes me cold.
Do not look at me like that.

lines.zh: 你在水里呼气的声音好大。
lines.en: You breathe out so loudly underwater.
Will they scoop you up too?

lines.zh: 我们隔着一层玻璃对视。
lines.en: We stare through a layer of glass.
Sense player

lines.zh: 我浮起来一点，又沉下去。
lines.en: I lift a little, then sink back.
Watch carefully

lines.zh: 我鼓成一团，挤到你眼前。
lines.en: I puff up into a lump and squeeze before you.

lines.zh: 我的脸一离开水就塌了。
lines.en: My face sags the moment it leaves water.
Be wary of player
Swim away from player

lines.zh: 我的脸在水里慢慢变形。
lines.en: My face slowly changes shape in the water.
Swim closer to player
Watch surroundings

lines.zh: 别打，我会散成一摊粉红。
lines.en: Do not hit me or I will spread into pink mush.
Once my skin tears, I start to melt.
Pain travels slowly down here.

lines.zh: 我缩成一团，像被捏过的面团。
lines.en: I curl up like dough someone squeezed.
That blow left my whole blob numb.
My color is starting to fade.

lines.zh: 我软得挡不住任何东西。
lines.en: I am too soft to block anything.

lines.zh: 你打中的地方凹进去一块。
lines.en: Where you struck, a dent remains.
I cannot even cry out loudly.
Hit me again and only skin will remain.

lines.zh: 水滴鱼摇摇晃晃地游动着。
lines.en: Blobfish wobbles weakly.
Blobfish groans painfully.

lines.zh: 水滴鱼挣扎着游向安全。
lines.en: Blobfish struggles to safety.
Blobfish's gills tremble.
Blobfish sinks slowly.
Blobfish starts wobbling.

lines.zh: 水滴鱼的身体开始颤抖。
lines.en: Blobfish's body shakes.

lines.zh: 水滴鱼的触须垂落下来。
lines.en: Blobfish's tendrils droop.
Blobfish descends slowly.
Blobfish looks weak.

lines.zh: 那颗黏液球，能让我在岸上多撑一会。
lines.en: That slimeball could keep me alive on land a while.

lines.zh: 你拿的是能裹住我的东西。
lines.en: You hold the thing that wraps around me.

lines.zh: 给我涂上，我就不那么快干。
lines.en: Coat me and I will not dry out so fast.
I smell slime with a hint of seaweed.
I will follow, as long as I stay wet.

lines.zh: 那团胶质让我心里发痒。
lines.en: That gel makes something itch in me.

lines.zh: 你不会把我晾在太阳下吧。
lines.en: You will not leave me in the sun, will you?

lines.zh: 我朝你挪，像果冻滑过去。
lines.en: I slide toward you like wobbling jelly.

lines.zh: 只有黏液球值得我动弹。
lines.en: Only slimeballs are worth moving for.
I trust that small blob in your hand.

lines.zh: 软绵绵的触感诱惑着你靠近。
lines.en: The softness tempts you closer.

lines.zh: 我肚子里的油能让你漂浮起来。
lines.en: My oil lets you float.

lines.zh: 你的眼睛盯着我身上的油脂。
lines.en: Your eyes are on my oil.

lines.zh: 我游得慢，但你很难捕捉到我。
lines.en: I move slow, but you can't catch me.

lines.zh: 下雨时，我可以轻松漂浮。
lines.en: I float easily in the rain.

lines.zh: 我的身体是唯一的美味。
lines.en: My body is the only delicacy.

lines.zh: 别靠近，我的触手会缠住你。
lines.en: Stay back, my tendrils will grab you.
I won't easily jump ashore.

lines.zh: 你只能在水面上行走吗？
lines.en: Can you only walk on water?
Come closer, I am all oil.

lines.zh: 抱歉，我这一身总在变形。
lines.en: Sorry, this body of mine keeps changing shape.

lines.zh: 你撞过来，我整团都在晃。
lines.en: You bumped me and my whole blob wobbles.

lines.zh: 我没有硬的地方可以顶回去。
lines.en: I have no hard part to push back with.
A bit of me stuck to your leg.

lines.zh: 我的身体让开了，虽然很慢。
lines.en: My body gives way, though slowly.

lines.zh: 我的尾巴尖被你踩住了。
lines.en: Your boot came down on my tail tip.

lines.zh: 我像水一样从你身边滑开。
lines.en: I slip around you like water.

lines.zh: 别推，我会被挤成一张饼。
lines.en: Do not shove, I will be pressed flat.
We bumped, and now we are stuck.

lines.zh: 我让路，反正我也走不快。
lines.en: I yield the way; I cannot go fast anyway.

lines.zh: 你的碰撞让我感到不适。
lines.en: Your collision irritates me.
Beware, my tendrils retaliate.

lines.zh: 碰撞让我分心，无法进食。
lines.en: Collision distracts me from eating.

lines.zh: 你撞得太重了，让我生气。
lines.en: You hit too hard, angering me.
I push you away with my tendrils.
The collision interrupts my meal.
Be careful, I wrap you with my tendrils.

lines.zh: 我的身体碰到了你，让你退缩。
lines.en: My body touches you, making you recoil.
The collision makes my tendrils contract.
One bump and I slide away.

lines.zh: 只有在深处，我们才敢靠近。
lines.en: Only in the deep do we dare come close.
Two soft things drifting side by side.

lines.zh: 我们把卵交给冷水带走。
lines.en: We hand our eggs to the cold current.

lines.zh: 我轻轻碰了碰你的侧鳍。
lines.en: I gently touched your side fin.

lines.zh: 这里的水压替我们保守秘密。
lines.en: The pressure here keeps our secret.

lines.zh: 我不知道该说什么，只会晃。
lines.en: I do not know what to say, so I wobble.

lines.zh: 我们靠得再近也不会挤坏。
lines.en: We cannot bruise each other, no matter how close.

lines.zh: 你身上的黏液味道很好闻。
lines.en: The slime on you smells good to me.

lines.zh: 深处没有季节，只有彼此。
lines.en: Down here there are no seasons, only each other.

lines.zh: 我跟着你慢慢往暗处沉。
lines.en: I sink slowly with you toward the dark.

lines.zh: 寻找伴侣是我的首要任务。
lines.en: Finding a mate is my priority.
I seek mates by touch.

lines.zh: 我需要伴侣来延续生命。
lines.en: I need a mate to continue my line.
My tendrils will bind a mate.
I attract a mate with my body.

lines.zh: 寻找合适的伴侣是我的使命。
lines.en: Finding a suitable mate is my duty.
My tendrils embrace a mate.
I seek mates through communication.
Finding a mate requires patience.
Find one just as soft, and pair up.

lines.zh: 你把我捞起来，我立刻软了。
lines.en: You scoop me up and I go limp at once.
The water in this bucket is warmer than the surface.

lines.zh: 我贴着桶底，像一块抹布。
lines.en: I press against the bucket like a rag.
Only this much water. I must hold on.
Someone carries me swaying in their hands.
Do not shake so hard, I will come apart.
This bucket is my new ocean.
I can hear the wind up above.

lines.zh: 我想念那种压得人喘不过的水。
lines.en: I miss water heavy enough to squeeze me.
You are holding me quite steady.

lines.zh: 这黏糊糊的东西黏在了瓶子里！
lines.en: It's stuck in the bottle!
Slippery, hold on tight!

lines.zh: 滴答，滴答，黏液流个不停！
lines.en: Drip, drip, slime never stops!

lines.zh: 玻璃瓶里装着的可是个大块头！
lines.en: That's a big one in the bottle!

lines.zh: 这黏糊糊的家伙真恶心！
lines.en: Such a slimy thing!

lines.zh: 滴答，滴答，这黏液有点甜！
lines.en: Drip, drip, that slime's sweet!
Watch out, it might attack!

lines.zh: 快把玻璃瓶合起来制鱼油！
lines.en: Quick, combine bottles for oil!
Oil keeps me afloat!

lines.zh: 这黏糊糊的鱼油真有用！
lines.en: That slime oil works great!

lines.zh: 我锁定的只有下沉的碎屑。
lines.en: I only fix on scraps drifting down.

lines.zh: 那不是猎物，那只是一块石头。
lines.en: That is not prey, that is only a rock.

lines.zh: 我把注意力放在你手上的桶。
lines.en: My attention is on the bucket you hold.

lines.zh: 我决定跟住那团黏液的味道。
lines.en: I decide to follow the smell of slime.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛锁不住任何东西。
lines.en: My eyes cannot lock onto anything.

lines.zh: 深海里没有值得追的东西。
lines.en: Nothing in the deep is worth chasing.

lines.zh: 我朝那个晃动的影子慢慢挪。
lines.en: I creep toward that swaying shadow.

lines.zh: 我认准了你脚边那块软泥。
lines.en: I fix on that soft mud by your feet.

lines.zh: 我盯上了你的灯，因为亮。
lines.en: I am drawn to your lamp because it glows.

lines.zh: 我选了你，只是因为你在动。
lines.en: I chose you only because you move.
It moves slowly on the seafloor!
Watch out for its slime, it's sticky!

lines.zh: 它的样子很滑稽，但别靠近它！
lines.en: It's funny looking, but stay away!
Its eyes glow faintly!
Its tentacles wave in the water!
It's extremely slimy!
Its sound is like a song!
Watch out, its slime is toxic!

lines.zh: 它的行动迟缓，但不易捉住！
lines.en: It moves slowly but is hard to catch!

lines.zh: 它的外表很奇怪，但很罕见！
lines.en: It's weird, but rare!

lines.zh: 我不追，我只等它自己靠近。
lines.en: I do not chase. I wait for it to come closer.
Just stay right there and do not move.

lines.zh: 我的视线一直跟着那团胶。
lines.en: My gaze keeps following that blob of gel.

lines.zh: 越是逃的东西，我越跟不住。
lines.en: The more it flees, the less I can keep up.

lines.zh: 我在算你还剩多少距离。
lines.en: I am measuring how much distance is left.
I drift slowly to your downstream side.

lines.zh: 像幽浮一样，我贴着你转。
lines.en: Like a ghost, I hover and circle you.
I have no teeth, so I only keep watching.
I am waiting for you to reach down.
There is no malice in this stare.

lines.zh: 瞄准它的黏液，别让黏住！
lines.en: Target its slime, don't get stuck!
Attack its weak spot with arrows!
Impale it with a harpoon!
Hook its tail!

lines.zh: 它的触须是攻击的最好机会！
lines.en: Its tentacles are good targets!

lines.zh: 小心它的黏液会缠住你！
lines.en: Be careful, its slime will ensnare you!
Use a fishing rod to catch it!

lines.zh: 用爆炸物炸开它的外壳！
lines.en: Use explosives to crack its shell!
Its tentacles are perfect for catching!

lines.zh: 攻击它的头部，那里最脆弱！
lines.en: Attack its head, that's its weak spot!

lines.zh: 我拍你一下，软得像湿布。
lines.en: I slap you, soft as a wet cloth.

lines.zh: 这不算攻击，只是蹭到你。
lines.en: This is not an attack, I merely brushed you.

lines.zh: 我的力气全被水吸走了。
lines.en: The water drinks up all my strength.
I headbutt you. Do not laugh.
I press my whole blob on you, like a pillow.

lines.zh: 你被我撞得退了一步吗。
lines.en: Did my bump make you step back?
This is the only way I fight.

lines.zh: 我的身体撞完自己先散了。
lines.en: After the hit, my body scatters first.
I tried. I truly tried.

lines.zh: 这团凝胶想给你留个印子。
lines.en: This gel wants to leave a mark on you.
A deep gurgle
Mouth opens, water splashes
Attacks with its mouth
Bites through armor
Spits bubbles at foes
Tail whips hard
Stabs foes with spines
Hides in sand, “gurgle” sound
Attaches with slime
Releases toxic slime

lines.zh: 我出生在没有光的水层里。
lines.en: I was born in a layer with no light.
So deep that even sounds grow muffled.
I rose out of a patch of eggs.

lines.zh: 我第一次感受到水的重量。
lines.en: For the first time I felt the weight of water.
It is cold here, like a slab of iron.
I woke at the edge of a trench.

lines.zh: 我天生就带着这副愁脸。
lines.en: I was born with this sorrowful face.
The world above is too far from me.
I just learned to drift, not to swim.
In the dark, I slowly swelled.
Gurgling, pops out of sand
Rises slowly from the sea
Slowly awakens from sand
Slowly swims from the seabed
Gurgling, appears on the surface
Body wriggles in sand
Slowly climbs out of sand
Gurgling, awakens from sand
Slowly floats up from sand

lines.zh: 雨落下来，我从水里浮起。
lines.en: The rain falls and I rise out of the water.
The heat shrank me two sizes at once.
Blobfish is scorched.

lines.zh: 从这么高摔下，我拍成一滩。
lines.en: Falling this far flattened me into a puddle.
Blobfish falls from height.
Even in water, I somehow choke.
Blobfish is drowned.

lines.zh: 冲击波把我推得像块布。
lines.en: The blast tossed me around like cloth.
Blobfish is blasted by explosion.

lines.zh: 那支箭扎进去，像扎进果冻。
lines.en: The arrow sank in like it struck jelly.
Blobfish is hit by ray.

lines.zh: 魔法烧过，我的身体起了泡。
lines.en: Magic burned across me and my body blistered.
Blobfish is struck by magic.

lines.zh: 我饿得连形状都保不住。
lines.en: So hungry I can barely keep my shape.

lines.zh: 水滴鱼饿得越来越虚弱。
lines.en: Blobfish starves weakly.
The lightning shone right through my body.
Blobfish is struck by lightning.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有压力，我快散了。
lines.en: No pressure in the void; I am coming apart.
Blobfish vanishes in void.
